step5_question.question_previous_version: Based on Procter & Gamble's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, what is P&G's free cash flow to sales ratio for fiscal 2026, and how does it compare to fiscal 2025? Report percentages rounded to one decimal place.
step5_question.gt_template:
Free Cash Flow to Sales Ratio is Free Cash Flow divided by Net Sales.
For 2026:
Free Cash Flow = Net Cash from Operating Activities - Capital Expenditures = $[[CFO@FY2026]] million - $[[Capex@FY2026]] million = $[[CFO@FY2026 - Capex@FY2026]] million
Net Sales = $[[Rev@FY2026]] million
Free Cash Flow to Sales Ratio = $[[CFO@FY2026 - Capex@FY2026]] million / $[[Rev@FY2026]] million = [[FCFtoSales@FY2026|.1f]]%
For 2025:
Free Cash Flow = $[[CFO@FY2025]] million - $[[Capex@FY2025]] million = $[[CFO@FY2025 - Capex@FY2025]] million
Net Sales = $[[Rev@FY2025]] million
Free Cash Flow to Sales Ratio = $[[CFO@FY2025 - Capex@FY2025]] million / $[[Rev@FY2025]] million = [[FCFtoSales@FY2025|.1f]]%
The ratio [[!FCFtoSales_change]] from [[FCFtoSales@FY2025|.1f]]% in 2025 to [[FCFtoSales@FY2026|.1f]]% in 2026.
